q: How many carbon credit certificates does a CCTS plant earn or have to buy?
title: CCTS certificates earned or bought
short: Under the 2025 target rules, a plant earns certificates equal to its target intensity minus its achieved intensity, multiplied by its equivalent product output that year. If it misses, it buys certificates equal to achieved minus target, times output. One certificate equals one tonne of CO2e.
audience: Obligated plants and their finance and energy teams

ul: Certificates issued = (target intensity minus achieved intensity) x equivalent product produced in the compliance year.
Certificates to buy = (achieved intensity minus target intensity) x equivalent product produced in the compliance year.
Intensity is in tonnes CO2e per tonne of equivalent product.
Form A, verified by an accredited agency, is due within four months after the compliance year ends.
BEE sends the report to NSC-ICM within two months of the Form A deadline.
NSC-ICM recommends issuance within two weeks, and BEE issues within two weeks after that, into the ICM registry.

example.title: Illustrative example: a cement plant beating its target
lines: Notified 2025-26 target for one Karnataka PPC plant: 0.4440 t CO2e per tonne
Assumed achieved intensity: 0.4400 t CO2e per tonne
Baseline output used as an assumption for 2025-26: 35,32,948 tonnes
example.note: The target is from the October 2025 schedule. Achieved intensity and output are assumptions; real figures come from the verified Form A.
